rows.label: Street address and assessor parcel number
rows.reason: Withheld by design: publishing it would identify the property or its owner.
rows.obtain: The owner already has it. Keep it out of this repository; record it only in a private working copy.

rows.label: Owner of record and how title is held (individual, trust, company)
rows.reason: Withheld by design: publishing it would identify the property or its owner.
rows.obtain: Owner's vesting deed or a preliminary title report, reviewed privately.

rows.label: Assessed value of land and building, and base year
rows.reason: Needs the parcel number, which is withheld.
rows.obtain: Look the parcel up on the Assessor Portal privately and record land value, improvement value and base year.

rows.label: Yearly property tax bill, direct assessments, and who pays it
rows.reason: Needs the parcel number and the lease.
rows.obtain: Latest secured property tax bill plus the lease clause on taxes; confirm whether the tenant pays the county directly.

rows.label: Zoning, overlays, community plan area and open planning cases
rows.reason: Needs the address, which is withheld.
rows.obtain: Search the parcel in ZIMAS privately; record zone, height district, overlays, specific plan and any case numbers.

rows.label: Lot size, building size, year built, drive-through, parking count
rows.reason: Needs the address, which is withheld.
rows.obtain: ZIMAS and Assessor records for lot and building size and year built; a site visit or survey for the drive-through lane and parking.

rows.label: Market value today
rows.reason: No official source publishes a market value for a single parcel; assessed value under Proposition 13 is not market value.
rows.obtain: A certified appraisal, or broker opinions of value from two net-lease brokers who state their comparables.

rows.label: Environmental record: past uses, underground tanks, open cleanup cases
rows.reason: Needs the address, which is withheld.
rows.obtain: Search the address in GeoTracker privately, and order a Phase I environmental site assessment before marketing or refinancing.

rows.label: Land value if the building were removed (redevelopment value)
rows.reason: Depends on zoning, lot size and comparable land sales, none of which is known here.
rows.obtain: Ask the appraiser for a land-residual value alongside the leased-fee value; it sets the floor if the tenant leaves.

rows.label: Who the tenant is: Jack in the Box Inc., a subsidiary, or a franchisee
rows.reason: Needs the lease, which this workbook has not seen.
rows.obtain: Read the lease's tenant name and any assignment; ask the tenant for the operating entity. This decides whose credit stands behind the rent.

rows.label: Building lease or ground lease (who owns the building)
rows.reason: Needs the lease, which this workbook has not seen.
rows.obtain: Lease premises clause and the clause on ownership of improvements at expiry.

rows.label: Current yearly rent
rows.reason: Needs the lease, which this workbook has not seen.
rows.obtain: Lease rent schedule and the last 12 months of rent receipts.

rows.label: Exact lease expiry date
rows.reason: Needs the lease, which this workbook has not seen. The brief gives only the window 2030 to 2035.
rows.obtain: Lease term clause plus any amendments and commencement-date memorandum.

rows.label: Renewal options: how many, how long, at what rent, and the notice window
rows.reason: Needs the lease, which this workbook has not seen.
rows.obtain: Lease option clause; put every notice deadline in a calendar.

rows.label: Rent increases during the term and in option periods
rows.reason: Needs the lease, which this workbook has not seen.
rows.obtain: Lease rent schedule; note whether increases are fixed or tied to an index, and any cap.

rows.label: Rent tied to sales (percentage rent)
rows.reason: Needs the lease, which this workbook has not seen.
rows.obtain: Lease percentage-rent clause and the tenant's sales reports, if the lease requires them.

rows.label: Who pays for taxes, insurance, roof, structure and parking lot
rows.reason: Needs the lease, which this workbook has not seen. 'NNN' is used loosely; some net leases leave roof and structure with the owner.
rows.obtain: Lease maintenance, repair, tax and insurance clauses.

rows.label: Guaranty of the lease
rows.reason: Needs the lease, which this workbook has not seen.
rows.obtain: Guaranty document, if any; check whether it survives assignment and option periods.

rows.label: Tenant's right to assign, sublet or stop operating while paying rent
rows.reason: Needs the lease, which this workbook has not seen.
rows.obtain: Lease assignment, subletting and continuous-operation clauses.

rows.label: Tenant's right of first refusal or option to buy
rows.reason: Needs the lease, which this workbook has not seen.
rows.obtain: Lease and any recorded memorandum; a right of first refusal changes how a sale must be run.

rows.label: Sales at this restaurant, and rent as a share of sales
rows.reason: The company publishes system-wide figures only, not sales for one restaurant.
rows.obtain: Request unit sales from the tenant (the lease may entitle the owner to them); compare rent to sales.

rows.label: Rent payment record and any defaults or disputes
rows.reason: Owner's records, not seen.
rows.obtain: Owner's rent ledger; request a tenant estoppel certificate before any sale.

rows.label: What the lease says after fire, earthquake or condemnation: who rebuilds, rent abatement, termination rights
rows.reason: Needs the lease, which this workbook has not seen. This clause decides who bears a disaster.
rows.obtain: Lease casualty and condemnation clauses, reviewed by a real-estate attorney.

rows.label: Insurance the lease requires, including earthquake cover, and who is the named insured
rows.reason: Needs the lease, which this workbook has not seen.
rows.obtain: Lease insurance clause and the tenant's current certificate of insurance.

rows.label: Expiry date of the franchise agreement for this restaurant, if franchised
rows.reason: Private between franchisor and franchisee. The company has said closures follow franchise agreement termination dates.
rows.obtain: Ask the tenant or operator directly; compare with the lease expiry.

rows.label: Whether this restaurant has been remodelled recently or is on a closure list
rows.reason: Not published for individual restaurants.
rows.obtain: Ask the tenant's real-estate department; check the city's building records for recent permits.

rows.label: Fire hazard severity zone
rows.reason: Needs the address, which is withheld.
rows.obtain: Enter the address in the State Fire Marshal's map viewer privately; record the zone and the map date.

rows.label: Flood zone
rows.reason: Needs the address, which is withheld.
rows.obtain: Search the address in the Flood Map Service Center privately; record the zone and panel date.

rows.label: Fault, liquefaction or landslide zone
rows.reason: Needs the address, which is withheld.
rows.obtain: Enter the address in EQ Zapp privately; record each of the three zones.

rows.label: Building structural type, and whether it is on a city retrofit list
rows.reason: Needs the address, which is withheld.
rows.obtain: City building records for the address; a structural engineer's walk-through if the building predates 1978.

rows.label: Insurance in force: carrier, limits, earthquake cover, deductible, premium, who pays
rows.reason: Owner's and tenant's policies, not seen.
rows.obtain: Current policies and certificates; ask the broker whether earthquake cover is in place and what the deductible is.

rows.label: Tax basis and depreciation taken
rows.reason: Withheld by design: publishing it would identify the property or its owner. It also sets the tax on a sale.
rows.obtain: Owner's tax returns and depreciation schedule, reviewed with a tax adviser.

rows.label: Loan on the property: balance, rate, maturity, prepayment cost
rows.reason: Withheld by design: publishing it would identify the property or its owner.
rows.obtain: Loan statement and note, reviewed privately.

rows.label: Income needs, other assets, time horizon and tolerance for loss
rows.reason: Withheld by design: publishing it would identify the property or its owner. It decides what 'manageable risk' means.
rows.obtain: A private conversation with the owner's financial adviser; record only the resulting constraints, not the figures.

rows.label: Estate plan and heirs
rows.reason: Withheld by design: publishing it would identify the property or its owner. It decides whether a step-up in basis is in play.
rows.obtain: Owner's estate attorney.

rows.label: Tax filing status, bracket and state of residence
rows.reason: Withheld by design: publishing it would identify the property or its owner.
rows.obtain: Owner's tax adviser.

rows.label: Residents, households and income within one and three miles
rows.reason: Needs the address, which is withheld. City and county figures are on the People and place page.
rows.obtain: With the address in hand, pull census-tract figures from data.census.gov for the tracts around the parcel.

rows.label: Planned transit, public works or rezoning within half a mile
rows.reason: Needs the address, which is withheld.
rows.obtain: ZIMAS for community plan updates and overlays; ask City Planning's public counter about pending plan changes.
